title: Cosmic Skeleton Fan
description: A skeletal figure with clasped hands emerges from dark swirling smoke in the lower center, holding a large ornate blue folding fan decorated with patterns. Above, a towering dark robed cosmic entity with multiple arms and a spiky crown floats in a starry sky, surrounded by glowing bubbles containing miniature scenes, while a green serpent-like creature coils through the composition amid colorful Buddha statues, flowers, and floating figures.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a skeletal figure rising from black smoke in the foreground holding a large ornate blue decorative folding fan with intricate patterns. A giant dark multi-armed cosmic goddess with a spiky crown floats in a starry night sky surrounded by transparent bubbles containing tiny figures and scenes. A large bright green serpent coils through the center connecting the realms. Colorful Buddha statues and vibrant flowers appear on the left and right. Highly detailed, vibrant fantasy illustration.
